mapper.sql: version_id, item_key, content_hash, page_path, title, sub_title, publish_date, target_path, visual_type, media_url, item_count, text_length, sort_no, first_sync_id, last_sync_id, create_by, create_time, create_time_utc, update_by, update_time, update_time_utc, remark

select sync_id, source_hash, result, page_count, entry_count, latest_date, current_seq, transfer_bytes, new_version_count, changed_kinds, cost_ms, message, trigger_type, sync_time, sync_time_utc, create_by, create_time, create_time_utc from option_update_sync
mapper.insert: insert into ${tableName} (item_key, content_hash, page_path, title, sub_title, publish_date, target_path, visual_type, media_url, item_count, text_length, sort_no, payload, first_sync_id, last_sync_id, create_by, create_time, create_time_utc, update_by, update_time, update_time_utc, remark) values (#{item.itemKey}, #{item.contentHash}, #{item.pagePath}, #{item.title}, #{item.subTitle}, #{item.publishDate}, #{item.targetPath}, #{item.visualType}, #{item.mediaUrl}, #{item.itemCount}, #{item.textLength}, #{item.sortNo}, #{item.payload}, #{item.firstSyncId}, #{item.lastSyncId}, #{item.createBy}, date_add(utc_timestamp(), interval 8 hour), utc_timestamp(), #{item.createBy}, date_add(utc_timestamp(), interval 8 hour), utc_timestamp(), #{item.remark})

insert into option_update_sync (source_hash, result, message, trigger_type, sync_time, sync_time_utc, create_by, create_time, create_time_utc) values (#{sourceHash}, #{result}, #{message}, #{triggerType}, date_add(utc_timestamp(), interval 8 hour), utc_timestamp(), #{createBy}, date_add(utc_timestamp(), interval 8 hour), utc_timestamp())
mapper.select: where result = 'UPDATED' order by sync_id desc limit 1
